frontend_smoke.evidence: In-app Browser offline homepage smoke at desktop and 390x844. Baseline reproduction completed the first nine questions, entered a valid January 1 birthday, and showed that Enter on the day field did nothing. After the change, an empty Continue submit showed the existing Choose one answer validation without navigation; both viewports then completed all ten questions and Enter on the day field revealed the personalized preview through the same guarded submit path. Focus moved to previewTitle, the share card appeared, the local-preview checkout guard remained visible, the URL never gained a day query, and neither viewport overflowed horizontally. The production API base stayed blank, and the final localhost requests were page/assets only with no API request. Question order, answer data, radio auto-advance, share/referral experiment, tracking, API, checkout, and paid-flow behavior were unchanged. This digest invalidates the evidence on later frontend changes.

paid_flow_e2e.evidence: Narrow digest waiver for routing the free quiz Continue button and final birthday-field Enter key through one guarded form submit handler. The script.js change only centralizes the existing free-question validation and preview reveal call, plus a day-field-only Enter bridge; the full-report HTML change is cache-revision synchronization only. The change does not alter question data, answer persistence, tracking payloads, checkout creation, payment verification, paid-answer submission, webhook handling, queueing, report generation, Resend delivery, or customer responses. Offline desktop/mobile Browser QA completed the free preview with the production API base blank, preserved the local-preview checkout guard, rendered the existing share card, and made no API request. No Lemon Squeezy transaction, webhook, report, or email was created; production payment/email E2E remains separately unauthorized, so this waiver is SKIPPED evidence rather than payment or fulfillment proof. Any later paid-flow digest change invalidates this waiver.
